skillExtracts.extract: name: memory recall description: "Search and recall relevant memories from past sessions via memsearch. Use when the user's question could benefit from historical context, past decisions, debugging notes, previous conversations, or project knowledge especially questions like 'what did I decide about X', 'why did we do Y', or 'have I seen this before'. Also use when you see [memsearch] Memory available hints injected
